features.feature: SEVERITY_TO_FINDING_KIND: typed const Record<FindingSeverity, FindingAddSeverity> mapping BLOCKER->critical, MAJOR->high, MINOR->medium
FindingAddSeverity type = critical|high|medium|low (finding_add enum, wider than the map to reserve low)
No abstract BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR value can reach finding_add (Zod-error prevention by structural typing)
composeDesc(finding): string = title — issue Fix: fix (line n) — exact §4.2 template with line cited inside desc
FindingAddArgs interface: severity FindingAddSeverity, desc string, files string[], category happy|edge|adversarial|missing, reviewRunId string, agent string

toFindingAddArgs(finding, {reviewRunId, agent, category}): maps severity via SEVERITY_TO_FINDING_KIND, composes desc, sets files=[finding.file], passes through reviewRunId/agent/category; pure — no finding_add call
agent in toFindingAddArgs must be caller-supplied (a real lattice-review-* lane); function never invents it
DEFAULT_SKEPTICS=2, DEFAULT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD=1 exported constants
VerifiedFinding interface: {finding, verdicts: Verdict[], confirms: number, confirmed: boolean}
verifyFinding: runs runSkeptic M times, collects Verdict[]; confirms = count(v.isReal===true) STRICT; confirmed = (confirms >= T); returns VerifiedFinding; M and T are tunable parameters
Refute-by-default: only isReal===true counts as confirm; isReal=false or undefined are refutes
Threshold-confirm NOT majority: CONFIRMED iff confirms >= T (default T=1-of-M=2, not majority which would require 2-of-2)
confirms=0 finding is dropped (confirmed=false); never reaches finding_add
runSkeptic is an injected (finding, change) => Verdict seam (hermetically testable with fake; real skeptic agent is MVP caller concern)
verifyFindings(findings, change, runSkeptic, opts): maps verifyFinding over array, each finding judged independently
confirmedFindings(verified: VerifiedFinding[]): Finding[] — returns only survivors with confirmed===true
